scope: Public libraries and references for structured-product pricing, risk and lifecycle implementation.

libraries.name: QuantLib/PyQL
libraries.role: barrier, curves, calendars, payoff scripting; reference Phoenix payoff
libraries.limitation: not a turnkey governed worst-of production dataset

libraries.name: OpenGamma Strata
libraries.role: market conventions, resolved products, risk primitives and curve infrastructure
libraries.limitation: Phoenix payoff needs custom product implementation

libraries.name: finmath-lib
libraries.role: multi-asset MC, Heston, best/worst-of, AAD and optional GPU extensions
libraries.limitation: Java integration and custom lifecycle mapping required

libraries.name: FinancePy
libraries.role: Python reference models for derivatives, barriers, curves and risk

libraries.name: vollib/py_vollib
libraries.role: vanilla Black/BSM pricing, IV and Greeks sanity checks

libraries.name: public Heston/worst-of GitHub pricers
libraries.limitation: license, tests, data provenance and production claims require review

committee_review.baseline: Phoenix canonical payoff/Monte Carlo engine with incomplete OOS evidence
committee_review.target: Add independent sanity checks and bounded challengers without changing production weights automatically
recommended_bounded_slice: finmath or public Heston/worst-of challenger in isolated adapter
Strata-inspired market snapshot and resolved-product lineage
acceptance_tests: Canonical payoff agrees on shared fixtures within tolerance
Date schedules and past fixings match across implementations
No proprietary code or unverified market evidence is imported
committee_review.next_experiment: Implement one isolated payoff adapter and compare against Phoenix fixtures before any integration.
committee_review.final_devin_validation: Library review recorded; no dependency or production logic changed.
